reason: UPHELD verdict survives; the facts check. (a) D1 as stated: dc0.30 on 6bba lab was +0.00131 (CONTEXT l.2650) and on public -0.005 (l.2796-2798). D2: fm45 POS, 0.954 U4 (l.2874). (b) DeepCenter was trained on 44b6 only (l.1571, l.2652). kaggle44b6_in_dorado.json places 63 of the 71 44b6 clips reliably (8 unreliable), so dorado is in-sample for DeepCenter. Its free boxes are also late frames only (t>=300). (c) Nothing ships: no submit, no runtime, no R8 exposure, and no closed line comes back. Two corrections to the wording. (1) 'The Ultrack pseudo-GT has no forks' is a choice in the protocol, not a fact about the data. tracks.npz has 186,459 parents with exactly 2 children. But cells per frame grow only 22.6k -> 37.9k (net +15k), and 14.6% of child tracklets last <= 5 frames. Spurious split/rejoin forks dominate the Ultrack forks, so they cannot serve as division truth, and the substance holds. (2) '63/71 train clips' should read '63/71 44b6 clips'. SHARPER CAVEAT: 6bba is already OUT-of-sample for DeepCenter and has REAL GT forks, yet it still got the dc0.30 sign wrong (0 TP / 6 FP removed forks). In-sampleness alone does not explain the lab/public flip: fork counts are tiny (151 GT divisions; 56% of train clips have none) and fork precision is specific to each embryo. A post-deadline LOEO OOF bed would still have low power for division knobs.
